global_batch_size.description: Total number of training samples processed per optimizer step. Larger values improve training stability but use more memory.
global_batch_size.hint: Choose from the available batch size options

learning_rate.description: Step size for weight updates during optimization. Controls how much model weights change per gradient step. Set lower for RL (e.g., 1e-5) to avoid policy collapse; higher for SFT/DPO (e.g., 1e-4).
learning_rate.hint: Must be a value between 1e-07 and 0.001

lora_alpha.description: LoRA scaling factor. The effective learning rate for LoRA adapters scales as alpha/rank. Typically set to 2x the LoRA rank.

lora_rank.description: Number of trainable dimensions in the LoRA adapter. Higher values increase model capacity but use more memory.

lr_scheduler.description: Learning rate decay schedule over training. Cosine anneals smoothly from peak to near-zero.

lr_warmup_steps_ratio.description: Fraction of total training steps spent gradually increasing the learning rate from zero. Helps stabilize early training.
lr_warmup_steps_ratio.hint: Must be a value between 0 and 1

max_epochs.description: Number of complete passes through the entire training dataset. More epochs allow the model to learn patterns more thoroughly but increase training time and risk of overfitting.
max_epochs.hint: Must be a value between 1 and 100

min_lr.description: Lowest learning rate the scheduler decays to during training. Prevents the learning rate from dropping to zero in later steps.
min_lr.hint: Must be a value between 0.0 and 1.0

mlflow_run_id.description: MLflow run ID for resuming or linking to an existing run

mlflow_tracking_uri.description: MLflow tracking server URI for experiment logging

model_name_or_path.description: Model identifier or path to pretrained model

name.hint: A training job with the name {name} will be created
name.invalid_format_error: It should be maximum 63 alphanumeric characters and cannot include spaces. It must also be unique within your account in an AWS Region

output_path.description: Local output path for model artifacts

results_directory.description: Directory for storing training results and logs

resume_from_path.description: Path to checkpoint for resuming training

train_val_split_ratio.description: Fraction of the dataset allocated to training versus validation. For example, 0.9 means 90% training and 10% validation.
train_val_split_ratio.hint: Must be a value between 0.0 and 1.0

warmup_steps.description: Absolute number of training steps over which the learning rate linearly warms up from 0 to the target value.
warmup_steps.hint: Must be a value between -1 and 100

weight_decay.description: L2 regularization coefficient applied to model weights during optimization. Helps prevent overfitting by penalizing large weights.

training_recipe.yaml:
display_name: Qwen 3.5 4B SFT LoRA Fine-Tuning
instance_types:
- ml.p5.48xlarge
- ml.p4de.24xlarge
- ml.p4d.24xlarge
run:
  model_type: verl
  name: '{{name}}'
  results_dir: '{{results_directory}}'
trainer:
  devices: 8
  num_nodes: 1
training_config:
  checkpoint:
    _target_: verl.trainer.config.CheckpointConfig
    load_contents:
    - model
    - optimizer
    - extra
    - hf_model
    save_contents:
    - model
    - optimizer
    - extra
    - hf_model
    save_only_adapter_if_lora: true
  data:
    custom_cls:
      name: null
      path: null
    ignore_input_ids_mismatch: false
    max_length: 4096
    max_token_len_per_gpu: 16384
    messages_key: messages
    micro_batch_size_per_gpu: 8
    pad_mode: no_padding
    train_batch_size: '{{global_batch_size}}'
    train_files: '{{data_path}}'
    train_max_samples: -1
    train_val_split_ratio: '{{train_val_split_ratio}}'
    truncation: right
    use_dynamic_bsz: true
    val_files: '{{validation_data_path}}'
    val_max_samples: -1
  engine:
    _target_: verl.workers.config.FSDPEngineConfig
    dtype: bfloat16
    entropy_checkpointing: false
    entropy_from_logits_with_chunking: false
    forward_only: false
    forward_prefetch: true
    fsdp_size: -1
    full_determinism: false
    model_dtype: bf16
    offload_policy: false
    optimizer_offload: false
    param_offload: false
    reshard_after_forward: true
    seed: 42
    strategy: fsdp2
    ulysses_sequence_parallel_size: 1
    use_orig_params: false
    use_torch_compile: true
    wrap_policy:
      min_num_params: 0
  mlflow:
    run_id: '{{mlflow_run_id}}'
    tracking_uri: '{{mlflow_tracking_uri}}'
  model:
    _target_: verl.workers.config.HFModelConfig
    custom_chat_template: null
    enable_activation_offload: false
    enable_gradient_checkpointing: true
    exclude_modules: null
    external_lib: null
    fused_kernel_options:
      impl_backend: torch
    hf_config_path: null
    lora_adapter_path: null
    lora_alpha: '{{lora_alpha}}'
    lora_rank: '{{lora_rank}}'
    override_config: {}
    path: '{{model_name_or_path}}'
    target_modules: all-linear
    tiled_mlp:
      enabled: false
      num_shards: 4
    tokenizer_path: null
    trust_remote_code: true
    use_fused_kernels: false
    use_liger: true
    use_remove_padding: true
    use_shm: false
  optim:
    _target_: verl.workers.config.FSDPOptimizerConfig
    betas:
    - 0.9
    - 0.95
    clip_grad: 1.0
    lr: '{{learning_rate}}'
    lr_scheduler_type: '{{lr_scheduler}}'
    lr_warmup_steps: '{{warmup_steps}}'
    lr_warmup_steps_ratio: '{{lr_warmup_steps_ratio}}'
    min_lr_ratio: '{{min_lr}}'
    num_cycles: 0.5
    optimizer: AdamW
    optimizer_impl: torch.optim
    override_optimizer_config: null
    total_training_steps: -1
    warmup_style: null
    weight_decay: '{{weight_decay}}'
  profiler:
    _target_: verl.utils.profiler.ProfilerConfig
    all_ranks: false
    enable: false
    ranks: []
    save_path: outputs/profile
    tool: torch
    tool_config:
      npu:
        _target_: verl.utils.profiler.config.NPUToolConfig
        analysis: true
        contents: []
        discrete: false
        level: level0
        name: npu
      nsys:
        _target_: verl.utils.profiler.config.NsightToolConfig
        discrete: null
        name: nsight
      torch:
        _target_: verl.utils.profiler.config.TorchProfilerToolConfig
        manual_save: true
        name: torch
        step_end: null
        step_start: 0
      torch_memory:
        _target_: verl.utils.profiler.config.TorchMemoryToolConfig
        name: torch_memory
        stack_depth: 32
        trace_alloc_max_entries: 100000
  trainer:
    default_hdfs_dir: null
    default_local_dir: '{{output_path}}'
    device: cuda
    experiment_name: qwen3_5_4b_sft_fsdp_lora_tatqa
    logger:
    - console
    - mlflow
    - tensorboard
    max_ckpt_to_keep: 3
    merge_lora_on_final_save: true
    n_gpus_per_node: 8
    nnodes: 1
    profile_interval:
    - -1
    - -1
    project_name: verl_sft_qwen3_5_4b
    resume_from_path: '{{resume_from_path}}'
    resume_mode: resume_path
    save_freq: after_each_epoch
    test_freq: -1
    total_epochs: '{{max_epochs}}'
    total_training_steps: null
  trainer_callbacks:
  - _target_: metering_callback.MeteringCallback
    output_path: /opt/ml/metering
version: 2.1.5
